layer_1_upper_soft_tpu_85a.structural_purpose: Flexible protective upper foot airframe. Sliced in soft 85A TPU with an expanded -0.30mm horizontal tolerance modifier to completely neutralize rubber thermal die-swell, ensuring the long T-shaped male splines slide smoothly into the sole without rubber-on-rubber friction seizure.

layer_2_sole_dense_tpu_95a.structural_purpose: Variable-density elephant-pad structural sole midsole. Sliced in high-durability 95A TPU. Perimeters bumped to 5 wall loops around the Debris Evacuation Wells, with internal channel walls expanded by 0.30mm to receive the upper rails smoothly while printing the front Overlocking Crocodile Hood Pocket supportless.

layer_3_insole_velvet_tpu_80a.structural_purpose: Removable zero-friction internal comfort insert liner. Sliced at an ultra-fine 0.12mm track out of highly elastic 80A TPU to provide a completely smooth, velvet-matte plane that eliminates heat spots.
